latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Notes of Video.

- Instantly extract and summarize key points from video files (lectures, meetings, etc.) via cloud AI.
- Upload, describe the summary or notes you want, and download a 1080p MP4 — all in about 30-60 seconds.
- Transparent status updates and easy connection: auto-handle tokens and session.
- Supports quick editing, batch processing, and iterative refinement of video notes and exports.
- Handles multiple formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, etc.) up to 500MB per file.
